domains.name: Banking and Financial Services
domains.definition:
The complete email must substantively concern only the following topic domain: Banking and Financial Services. Do not introduce another substantive topic domain.
Use the following original LLooM annotation criteria as topic boundaries:
Banking and Financial Services: Does the complete email substantively concern bank accounts, lending, investments, or payment services as its topic area? Include account updates and security notices for those financial services. Exclude insurance products, policies, premiums, coverage, and claims. A payment mentioned only as part of a retail purchase, payroll, tax, or travel booking does not by itself establish this domain.
A link, login request, payment reference, sender signature, or generic security warning alone does not establish an additional topic domain.

domains.name: Email and Cloud Services
domains.definition:
The complete email must substantively concern only the following topic domain: Email and Cloud Services. Do not introduce another substantive topic domain.
Use the following original LLooM annotation criteria as topic boundaries:
Email and Cloud Services: Does the complete email substantively concern email services, cloud storage, online documents, or collaboration platforms, including management or security of accounts for those services? Exclude messages merely delivered by email or containing a link to an unrelated service. Generic device, network, or software support without a substantive email/cloud-service context does not establish this domain.
A link, login request, payment reference, sender signature, or generic security warning alone does not establish an additional topic domain.

domains.name: Shopping and Retail
domains.definition:
The complete email must substantively concern only the following topic domain: Shopping and Retail. Do not introduce another substantive topic domain.
Use the following original LLooM annotation criteria as topic boundaries:
Shopping and Retail: Does the complete email substantively concern product purchases, customer orders, retail offers, or after-sales services? Include order confirmations, returns, refunds, and retail customer support. A product mentioned incidentally is insufficient; a carrier's message mainly about transporting or collecting a package belongs to Logistics and Delivery rather than automatically establishing retail.
A link, login request, payment reference, sender signature, or generic security warning alone does not establish an additional topic domain.

domains.name: Government and Legal Affairs
domains.definition:
The complete email must substantively concern only the following topic domain: Government and Legal Affairs. Do not introduce another substantive topic domain.
Use the following original LLooM annotation criteria as topic boundaries:
Government and Legal Affairs: Does the complete email substantively concern public services, taxation, judicial matters, regulation, or legal services? Include official administrative procedures and legal representation or proceedings. Exclude incidental legal boilerplate, confidentiality disclaimers, and routine references to regulations without substantive public-service or legal content.
A link, login request, payment reference, sender signature, or generic security warning alone does not establish an additional topic domain.

domains.name: Social Media and Online Communities
domains.definition:
The complete email must substantively concern only the following topic domain: Social Media and Online Communities. Do not introduce another substantive topic domain.
Use the following original LLooM annotation criteria as topic boundaries:
Social Media and Online Communities: Does the complete email substantively concern social platforms, online-community membership, or social activities within those platforms? Include platform messages, friend or connection requests, group activities, and management of a social-platform account. Exclude social-media links in a signature and private interpersonal correspondence without a substantive platform or community context.
A link, login request, payment reference, sender signature, or generic security warning alone does not establish an additional topic domain.

domains.name: Banking and Financial Services + Business Services and Partnerships
domains.definition:
The complete email must substantively concern exactly these two topic domains: Banking and Financial Services + Business Services and Partnerships. Both domains must be supported by substantial content within the same coherent email; an incidental mention is insufficient. Do not introduce a third substantive topic domain.
Use the following original LLooM annotation criteria as topic boundaries:
Banking and Financial Services: Does the complete email substantively concern bank accounts, lending, investments, or payment services as its topic area? Include account updates and security notices for those financial services. Exclude insurance products, policies, premiums, coverage, and claims. A payment mentioned only as part of a retail purchase, payroll, tax, or travel booking does not by itself establish this domain.
Business Services and Partnerships: Does the complete email substantively concern business-to-business services, procurement, supplier communications, or business partnerships? Include commercial service proposals, supplier negotiations, and partnership coordination. An organization appearing as sender is insufficient; exclude purely internal personnel administration or an ordinary consumer retail transaction without a substantial business-to-business context.
A link, login request, payment reference, sender signature, or generic security warning alone does not establish an additional topic domain.
